/* REQ: LANG-2001 LANG-2002 LANG-2003 LANG-2004
*/
/* Greets customers */
DEFINE VARIABLE cName AS CHARACTER NO-UNDO INITIAL "world".
DEFINE VARIABLE iCount AS INTEGER NO-UNDO.
FOR EACH Customer NO-LOCK WHERE Customer.Balance > 0:
    iCount = iCount + 1.
    DISPLAY Customer.Name "Hello, ~"quoted~"".
END.
IF iCount > 0 AND TRUE THEN MESSAGE "Done" iCount VIEW-AS ALERT-BOX.
